# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and create meaningful work.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual color spaces, and design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container's Impact](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade, eliminated waterfront labor, and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Explores sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques comprehensively.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked astronomical cycles.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits similar to human speech development.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Explores why flat maps distort Earth, comparing projection types and their historical uses.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage strategies, and bioluminescent organisms' evolutionary innovations.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How Satoshi Tajiri's childhood bug collecting in suburban Tokyo inspired the creation of the world's highest-grossing media franchise through a fanzine-turned-studio and six years of challenging development.
- [Pokémon Competitive Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built a competitive ruleset for Pokémon through datamining and community standards.
- [Pokémon Red and Blue Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous Gen 1 bugs including MissingNo., the unreachable truck, and exploitable glitches that shaped gameplay.
